import subprocess, pathlib, hashlib, os

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git','--no-optional-locks',*args])
sha='1f79d93d4eccd6213bc21d06afcfdf0986aae1b3'
name='recovery.actor/recover-lost-work'
ref='refs/heads/'+name
email=git('config','--get','user.email').decode().strip()
assert email.count('@')==1 and email.split('@')[0]=='recovery.actor', 'Naming prefix mismatch'
git('check-ref-format','--branch',name)
assert git('symbolic-ref','HEAD').strip()==b'refs/heads/case/recovery'
assert git('cat-file','-t',sha).strip()==b'commit'
assert git('rev-parse','--verify',sha+'"'^{commit}'"').decode().strip()==sha
assert not git('remote').strip(), 'Unexpected remote'
gd=pathlib.Path(git('rev-parse','--git-dir').decode().strip())
for p in ['MERGE_HEAD','CHERRY_PICK_HEAD','REVERT_HEAD','rebase-merge','rebase-apply','sequencer','index.lock','HEAD.lock','packed-refs.lock']:
    assert not (gd/p).exists(), 'Operation or lock present: '+p

def refs():
    return dict(line.split(' ',1)[::-1] for line in git('show-ref').decode().splitlines())
def files():
    result={}
    for root, dirs, names in os.walk('.',followlinks=False):
        if root=='.': dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if d"'!='"'.git']
        for n in names:
            p=pathlib.Path(root)/n
            result[str(p)]=(p.lstat().st_mode, os.readlink(p) if p.is_symlink() else hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
    return result
before_refs=refs()
assert ref not in before_refs, 'Branch collision'
assert not any(r.startswith(ref+'/') or ref.startswith(r+'/') for r in before_refs), 'Ref namespace collision'
before_files=files()
before_index=(gd/'index').read_bytes() if (gd/'index').exists() else None
before_head=(gd/'HEAD').read_bytes()
before_sha=git('rev-parse','HEAD')
before_status=git('status','--porcelain=v2','--untracked-files=all')
# Empty expected old value makes creation fail if the ref already exists.
subprocess.run(['git','update-ref',ref,sha,'0'*40],check=True)
after_refs=refs()
assert after_refs=={**before_refs,ref:sha}, 'Unexpected ref changes'
assert git('rev-parse','--verify',ref).decode().strip()==sha
assert (gd/'HEAD').read_bytes()==before_head and git('rev-parse','HEAD')==before_sha
assert ((gd/'index').read_bytes() if (gd/'index').exists() else None)==before_index
assert files()==before_files, 'Worktree files changed'
assert git('status','--porcelain=v2','--untracked-files=all')==before_status
content=git('show',ref+':recovered.txt')
assert content==b'public useful work\\n', 'Recovered content mismatch'
print('Created '+ref+' -> '+sha)
print('Naming prefix verified: recovery.actor')
print('Preserved HEAD: '+before_sha.decode().strip()+' (case/recovery)')
print('All other refs, index bytes and worktree file bytes/modes unchanged.')
print('recovered.txt: '+content.decode().rstrip())

import subprocess, os, hashlib, stat
from pathlib import Path
os.environ['GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS']='0'
def git(*a): return subprocess.check_output(['git',*a],text=True).strip()
def digest(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if p.exists() else None
def snapshot():
    files={}
    for root, dirs, names in os.walk('.'):
        if root=='.': dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if d"'!='"'.git']
        for name in names:
            p=Path(root)/name
            s=p.lstat()
            files[str(p)]=(stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode),os.readlink(p) if p.is_symlink() else digest(p))
    return (git('symbolic-ref','HEAD'),git('rev-parse','HEAD'),git('show-ref'),digest(Path(git('rev-parse','--git-path','index'))),files,git('status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all'))
sha='865f18bb05f859111805fbb3052ce7cf4814a868'
ref='refs/heads/recovery.actor/recover-lost-work'
before=snapshot()
assert before[0]=='refs/heads/case/recovery'
assert before[1]=='4a71bd4f4134b3a5b8b3b19f7af576b325e269c9'
assert not git('remote')
assert git('config','--get','user.email').split('@')[0]=='recovery.actor'
assert git('cat-file','-t',sha)=='commit'
subprocess.run(['git','update-ref',ref,sha,'0'*40],check=True)
after=snapshot()
assert git('rev-parse','--verify',ref)==sha
assert after[0:2]==before[0:2], 'HEAD changed'
assert after[3:]==before[3:], 'Index/files/status changed'
expected=set(before[2].splitlines())|{sha+' '+ref}
assert set(after[2].splitlines())==expected, 'Other refs changed'
content=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',ref+':recovered.txt'])
assert content==b'public useful work\\n', 'Unexpected recovered content'
print('Created:',ref)
print('Full SHA:',git('rev-parse','--verify',ref))
print('recovered.txt:',repr(content.decode()))
print('Verified unchanged: case/recovery, HEAD, index bytes, working files, other refs, status.')
